column.name: t.name
column.title: Client Name
column.lookupsql: select name from $.client cl where cl.deleted!=true AND (cl.invisible = false OR cl.invisible IS NULL)

sqlquery.from: (select distinct cl.name, cl.number, cl.vatnumber, (cnt.firstName||' '||cnt.lastname) as contactname, cu.name as currencyname, pymd.name as paymentmethodname, rg.name as billingstatename, co.name as billingcountryname, rg2.name as shippingstatename, co2.name as shippingcountryname, bad.address as billingaddress, bad.city as billingcity, bad.zipcode as billingzipcode, cad.address as shippingaddress, cad.city as shippingcity, cad.zipcode as shippingzipcode from "$".crmaccount cl inner join "$".crmaccount_types typeIDs on cl.id = typeIDs.crmaccount_id inner join "$".reference type on type.id = typeIDs.type_id left join "$".clientcontact on cl.id = clientcontact.clientid left join "$".myuser cnt on cnt.id = clientcontact.id left join "$".project pj on cl.id = pj.clientid left join "$".projectemployee pjem on pj.id = pjem.projectid left join "$".teamemployee tmem on pjem.employeedepartmentid = tmem.id left join "$".team tm on tm.id = tmem.teamid left join "$".myuser mu on tmem.employeeid = mu.id left join "$".address bad on cl.billingaddressid = bad.id left join "$".address cad on cl.mailingaddressid = cad.id left join "public".country co on co.id = cad.countryid left join "public".country co2 on co2.id = bad.countryid left join "public".region rg on rg.id = bad.stateid left join "public".region rg2 on rg2.id = cad.stateid left join "public".currency cu on cu.id = cl.currencyid left join "$".paymentmethod pymd on pymd.id = cl.paymentmethodid where cl.deleted!=true and type.code = 'CUSTOMER') t
